plan.summary: Fix Voice Test ops-mode auth gap: Dashboard ops login (useAuth.ts loginWithOps) writes Basic Auth credentials to sessionStorage.ops_auth but does NOT mint a JWT to localStorage.access_token. The Voice Test sidebar button (Layout.tsx:153) only knew the localStorage.access_token path, so ops-mode users hit 'Oturum bulunamadı (JWT yok). Dashboard\'a login olun.' alert despite being logged in. Add a backend JWT-mint endpoint /ops/voice-jwt (Basic Auth in, JSON token out, 30min TTL, tenant=0 superadmin) and extend the Layout.tsx button with the same two-path pattern already used by the Hangfire link (try localStorage.access_token first, fall back to Basic Auth + /ops/voice-jwt exchange). This unblocks Voice Test for ops-mode callers (super.invekto.com production path).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Backend Program.cs'e yeni endpoint: GET /ops/voice-jwt (Basic Auth zorunlu, ValidateOpsAuth gate). Basarili durumda JSON `{token: <jwt>, expires_in: 1800, token_type: "Bearer"}` donus + JsonLines log entry. Basarisiz Basic Auth: HTTP 401 + JSON `{error: 'unauthorized'}` + WARN log INV-AUTH-001. JwtGenerator null ise HTTP 503 + ERROR log INV-AUTH-001.

JWT mint: jwtGenerator.GenerateServiceToken(0, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30)) -- tenant=0 superadmin, 30dk TTL, source='voice_runtime' (mevcut JwtGenerator.GenerateServiceToken pattern). expires_in response field=1800 (30*60). 8 saatlik quicklogin disinda short-lived secim (voice test ops/demo tool).

Layout.tsx Voice Test button (line 153, item.path==='external:voice-test') iki auth path: (1) localStorage.access_token varsa direkt openVoicePoc(t) cagrir. (2) Yoksa sessionStorage.ops_auth check; varsa GET /ops/voice-jwt Basic Auth header ile, JSON parse, data.token validation (typeof === 'string' && length > 0), sonra openVoicePoc(data.token). 3-katmanli error handling: fetch reject (network), HTTP !ok (status code body), invalid JSON shape (typeof check).

Existing voice-poc.html ?token= URL-bridge AD-33 davranisi DEGISMEDI -- voice-poc.html'in inline script'i window.INVEKTO_VOICE_JWT + history.replaceState ile token'i URL'den temizler. Backend yeni endpoint sadece JSON donduyor, voice-poc.html ile etkilesimi YOK.

Backward-compat: INMA-session callers (localStorage.access_token var) icin davranis IDENTIK -- mevcut F0.5 flow (token query param) korunur. Sadece Ops-mode fallback eklendi. Hicbir regression yok mevcut INMA path icin.
